pages.title: Archery XP
pages.text: You gain archery XP by landing hits, headshots, long-range shots, and kills — never from the practice dummy. Each level costs a little more than the last, and XP is never lost on death.

pages.title: Skill Tree
pages.text: Every level grants a point to spend across three branches:$(br)$(li)$(l)Draw$() — faster draw$(li)$(l)Crit$() — chance to crit$(li)$(l)Aim$() — tighter spread, and a longer grace before a flax string starts to shake.
